name: kwegereza-live-class
description: Kwegereza Islam Umuryango - standalone live-class service. This service has NO database of its own: everything that needs persistence (class records, attendance, notification fan-out, activity tracking) goes through the main Kwegereza-BackEnd's internal API (see src/utils/internalApi.ts), reached purely over HTTPS with a shared secret, never a direct database connection. Real-time WebRTC media (audio, screen share) is handled entirely by a separately-hosted LiveKit server, reached via livekit-server-sdk. See README.md.
